title: The Pale Vector
author: Silas Winterbourne
blurb: Paloma Zhou, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
